text:
Alice - AE: FYI Zenara hit a blocker on the presales side — they need SSO (Azure AD SAML), SCIM group sync with nested groups, RBAC mapping to our role model, and domain ownership proofing but their DNS provider won't allow apex TXT records. legal also flagged EU data residency + audit retention requirements. Can we scope a POC and clear blockers?
Ben - Solutions Eng: Thanks Alice. Quick plan: 1) POC scope = SAML SSO + SCIM group sync (including nested groups) + RBAC role mapping + audit log access. 2) Acceptance criteria: successful login via Azure AD, SCIM group create/patch/delete observed on our side, RBAC enforcement on a protected API, and retrieval of signed audit logs for a 7-day window. 3) Questions: do they need dedicated/private infra for EU residency or will hosted EU region suffice? And do they require HSM/KMS for signing keys?
Chandra - Platform Eng: Technical notes: SCIM should be delta-based; nested groups mean we'll push groups with members referencing other group IDs, but many IdPs flatten nested groups — we should confirm with their AD team. If they can't do apex TXT we can accept a CNAME verification flow (we support that) but it requires a short TTL and a specific CNAME target. Also: our SCIM expects a service account token with 'scim:write' scope. Example SCIM PATCH we typically ask for in the POC (fyi):
```json
{
  "Operations": [
    {
      "op": "add",
      "path": "members",
      "value": [ { "value": "user-123", "type": "User" } ]
    }
  ]
}
```
Chandra - Platform Eng: Also we need their SAML metadata (IdP metadata xml), and a test user that can trigger group-sync events. For RBAC mapping send a CSV like `okta_group,redwood_role,env_scope` — we'll import it.
Dana - Security: On EU residency and keys: we can run the POC in our EU Private control plane (Redwood Private) to satisfy data residency and audit requirements. For key handling we support KMS/HSM integration for signing/rotation; if they require customer-managed keys we need contract addendum + SOC2 encryption-in-transit details. I'll attach the mini-checklist they usually ask for in the questionnaire: 1) SOC2/ISO artifacts (available), 2) Retention window for audit logs (we can offer 90/365/indefinite on Dedicated/Private), 3) SAML assertion lifetime and encryption policy (configurable), 4) SCIM tokens lifecycle and rotation cadence.
Ben - Solutions Eng: Pricing (very rough for presales ask): Hosted EU region: standard hosted + POC support = no infra charge, $5k POC services (3 engineers, 2 weeks). Dedicated/Private EU: minimum monthly commitment ~ $18k/mo + onboarding $15k (if they want KMS/HSM + longer retention add $2–5k/mo). We can tighten these numbers after legal/finance review. :thinking_face:
Alice - AE: Good — can we get a timeline? Customer wants a 2-week POC, 1st week integration, 2nd week soak + acceptance. Who owns each deliverable?
Ben - Solutions Eng: I can own integration runbooks and mapping import. Chandra will spin up the POC env and provide the SCIM endpoint/token and the CNAME proof target. Dana will own security questionnaire responses and required artifacts. Target kickoff Tuesday next week, deliverables checklist by day 2, demo at end of week 2.
Chandra - Platform Eng: I'll provision an EU Private POC env (requested) once legal confirms contract addendum for customer-managed keys (if needed). Expected time to env-ready ~48h after request. For audit logs we expose an S3-compatible signed bundle with SHA256 + timestamped manifest.
Ben - Solutions Eng: For the RBAC mapping example I'll send a template CSV in the next message and a short script to validate mapping semantics.
deploy-bot: POC environment created: zenara-poc-eu-01 (namespace) — endpoints emailed to Ben. :white_check_mark:
Alice - AE: Awesome. Next steps: Ben please send pricing slide + RBAC CSV template, Chandra please confirm CNAME target and SCIM token expiry, Dana please attach SOC2 summary. I'll loop legal and customer's IdP team and schedule the kickoff. Thanks all :thumbsup:
